cim: Google value plummets by $500 billion as artificial intelligence searches impact ad revenue.
cim_eredeti: Google value plummets by $500 billion as artificial intelligence searches impact ad revenue.
szoveg_eredeti:
Google's parent company Alphabet has lost more than $500 billion in market value after warning that AI-generated search summaries are affecting advertising revenue, while investors grow increasingly concerned about the enormous cost of the technology race.

prioritas.lead_hu: Az Alphabet piaci értéke jelentősen csökkent, miután a vállalat jelezte, hogy az AI-alapú keresési összefoglalók kedvezőtlenül befolyásolják a hirdetési bevételeket.
